children: Nike is clearing out its inventory and cutting back on promotions to try to return its brands to growth, Chief Executive Elliott Hill says during an investor day call. The company is facing pressure because classic franchises across all three of its major brands are declining from their peaks, Hill says. Nike is now trying to be more disciplined about how it manages those franchises, he says. The goal is to streamline brands and drive more full-price sales. While those moves could weigh on near-term revenue, Hill says they are necessary. "I want to be clear we're not where we want to be," Hill says. (katherine.hamilton@wsj.com)
